combo.description: To get away and combo safely E then instantly Flash and Q. Quickly use W then continue to AA.
Your full combo is W AA instantly followed by E Q R as quickly as you can. Continue to AA until you can R to execute.
For a quick burst E and instantly Q R.
A common fight opener is to E and instantly Q R. Follow up by quickly using W and then AA'ing.
To trade Q E instantly, quickly W and then AA.
For a longer trade W AA instantly followed by E Q as quickly as you can, then continue to AA.
